tests.name: distribute returns the ratios unchanged (same reference) when the ratios sum to zero
distribute returns the ratios unchanged when positive and negative ratios cancel out to zero
distribute returns an empty array when given an empty ratios array
distribute distributes an amount proportionally when it divides evenly (no remainder)
distribute keeps shares in the same order as the input ratios
distribute distributes a value of zero as all-zero shares
distribute gives a single ratio the entire amount
distribute assigns the remainder to the share(s) with the largest ratio first, in input order
distribute prioritizes the largest ratio for the remainder regardless of its position in the input
distribute distributes a multi-unit remainder across multiple indices by descending ratio
distribute skips zero-ratio entries when distributing the remainder
distribute gives the sole remainder unit to the largest ratio even when all raw shares truncate to zero
distribute distributes an equal-ratio amount so shares sum to the original value (remainder spread as a multiset)
distribute distributes a small equal-ratio amount correctly
distribute handles negative values by truncating toward zero and distributing the negative remainder
distribute handles negative values with distinct ratios deterministically
distribute does not hang and still returns a well-formed result for values beyond Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
